sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE LOWER CO RIVER VALLEY SHOULD TRACK E TO THE SRN ROCKIES BY 10/00Z...BEFORE ADVANCING MORE SLOWLY NE OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS TONIGHT. LEE CYCLOGENESIS WILL OCCUR TODAY OVER SE/E-CNTRL CO. A WARM FRONT SHOULD DEVELOP E OVER KS TODAY AND EVENTUALLY NE TOWARDS THE MID-MO VALLEY TONIGHT. DRYLINE WILL MIX E OVER THE SRN HIGH PLAINS BUT ITS ADVANCEMENT SHOULD BE SLOWED BY MORNING CONVECTION. CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW/CURRENT EFFECTIVE FRONTAL BOUNDARY FROM N-CNTRL TX TO THE PERMIAN BASIN WILL ATTEMPT TO ADVANCE N BUT MAY BE STUNTED BY MORNING CONVECTION OVER THE SRN HIGH PLAINS. A PACIFIC COLD FRONT SHOULD OVERTAKE THE DRYLINE TONIGHT.

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN GREAT PLAINS
sections.text: ANOTHER MESSY/COMPLEX FORECAST AS EXTENSIVE CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING OCCURRED ON FRI AND MORNING CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO BE ONGOING. CONVECTIVELY PARAMETRIZED GUIDANCE APPEARS LIKELY TO BE TOO UNSTABLE IN THE PORTION OF THE WARM SECTOR N OF THE LARGE-SCALE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY CURRENTLY FROM N-CNTRL TX TO THE PERMIAN BASIN. WHILE A HIGHER-END SCENARIO IS CERTAINLY POSSIBLE TODAY...BUST POTENTIAL IS ALSO APPARENT. FOR THIS OUTLOOK...WILL FOCUS ON TWO CORRIDORS OF MORE CONCENTRATED SEVERE POTENTIAL WITHIN A BROADER ORGANIZED SEVERE RISK. TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP THIS MORNING IN BETWEEN ONGOING ACTIVITY OVER ERN CO AND THE PERMIAN BASIN. LARGE-SCALE ASCENT WILL BECOME PRONOUNCED AS MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS/DCVA INCREASE AND ROBUST LOW-LEVEL WAA OCCURS ATOP THE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW IN W TX. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD WITH THESE EARLY-DAY STORMS. SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY MAY INTENSIFY IN CONCERT WITH THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE...PARTICULARLY ALONG THE CURRENT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AS IT ATTEMPTS TO ADVANCE N OVER N TX AND OK. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR PROFILES WOULD FAVOR ALL SEVERE HAZARDS...BUT LIKELY MESSY CONVECTIVE MODE AND LACK OF STRONG DIABATIC HEATING SUGGESTS THE OVERALL RI

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MAIN UPPER-AIR FEATURE OF INFLUENCE FOR THIS FCST WILL REMAIN WELL-DEFINED CYCLONE...NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER NRN AZ. ASSOCIATED 500-MB LOW IS FCST TO PIVOT ENEWD THEN NEWD ACROSS SRN ROCKIES THIS PERIOD...REACHING CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS BY 12Z. WEAK PERTURBATION TO ITS E OVER NM WILL PIVOT NEWD ACROSS ERN HIGH PLAINS THROUGH LATE MORNING. SFC SITUATION IS VERY MESSY THIS MORNING. MULTIPLE ROUNDS OF MCS ACTIVITY DURING PAST FEW DAYS HAVE LEFT AN AGGREGATE BOUNDARY FROM REMNANTS OF LATEST MCS OVER WRN TN/SERN AR...SWWD ACROSS NWRN LA...THEN WWD ACROSS N-CENTRAL TX IN WAVY FORM...THEN WSWWD AGAIN INTO SFC LOW N MAF. WHERE NOT SHUNTED SWD OR DELAYED BY ONGOING/ADDITIONAL CONVECTION TO ITS N...THIS BOUNDARY IS EXPECTED TO BECOME PROGRESSIVELY MORE DIFFUSE/SHALLOW AND LIFT NWD TODAY ACROSS RED RIVER REGION. REMNANT SYNOPTIC FRONTAL ZONE HAS BECOME VERY ILL-DEFINED OVER NRN/WRN OK AND APPEARS TO BE RE-DEVELOPING ACROSS ERN...S-CENTRAL AND NWRN KS. LEE CYCLONE WILL DEVELOP/DEEPEN TODAY OVER SERN CO BEFORE EJECTING NEWD ACROSS NWRN KS OVERNIGHT. PAC COLD FRONT ATTACHED TO THAT LOW WILL MOVE EWD OVER CENTRAL/SRN HIGH PLAINS...OVERTAKING BOTH RESIDUAL/MODIFYING MCS-OUTFLOW A

sections.title: CENTRAL/SRN PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED TO LOCALLY NUMEROUS TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO SHIFT NEWD ACROSS SWATH FROM SERN CO TO WRN/CENTRAL OK AND NW TX THROUGH MIDDAY AND EARLY AFTN...OFFERING OCCASIONAL LARGE HAIL AND STG/DAMAGING GUSTS. ACTIVITY WILL BE SUPPORTED BY COMBINATION OF DCVA IN EJECTING SHORTWAVE AND STG SELY LLJ AND RELATED WAA/MOISTURE TRANSPORT -- EACH ABOVE BOUNDARY LAYER THAT HAS BEEN COOLED/STABILIZED BY COMBINATION OF COLD FROPA IN NWRN PARTS AND EARLIER MCS ACTIVITY. REF WWS 147/148 AND RELATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR MORE NEAR-TERM DETAILS. SUBSEQUENTLY...SUFFICIENT DESTABILIZATION TO SUPPORT ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED DRYLINE SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE BY MID-LATE AFTN IN NARROW NW-SE-ORIENTED CORRIDOR OF AIR-MASS RECOVERY AND DIABATIC HEATING FOLLOWING MORNING PRECIP. THIS LIKELY WILL INCLUDE RISK FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED DAMAGING HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES...GIVEN STRENGTH OF DEEP SHEAR...AND OF LOW-LEVEL SHEAR JUST AHEAD OF DRYLINE. COVERAGE OF SUCH CONVECTION SHOULD BE RELATIVELY MAXIMIZED IN ARC FROM ERN CO SEWD ACROSS WRN KS TO NERN PANHANDLES/NWRN OK REGION...AND HAIL/TORNADO PROBABILITIES SUPPORTING ENH RISK ARE BEING MAINTAINED IN MUCH OF THIS SWATH. HOWEVER...CONCERNS ABOUT ST

sections.title: COASTAL CAROLINAS
sections.text: MHX/ILM VWP DATA HAVE SHOWN SUFFICIENTLY LARGE LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS FOR SUPERCELLS FOR MANY HOURS...HOWEVER MAIN CONCERN HAS BEEN SUFFICIENT DESTABILIZATION/MOISTENING WITHIN PRIOR SUBTROPICAL CYCLONE MODE TO SUPPORT SUSTAINED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IN AREAS N-NE OF CENTER. WITH TROPICAL CHARACTERISTICS BECOMING MORE COMMON PER NHC DISCUSSIONS/ADVISORIES...THIS PROCESS GRADUALLY SHOULD YIELD MORE POTENTIAL WITH TIME FOR MINI-SUPERCELLS AND SMALL BOWS PERIPHERAL TO CIRCULATION ENVELOPE...BUT STILL IN FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR...OFFERING MRGL POTENTIAL FOR A TORNADO OR DAMAGING CONVECTIVE GUST. REF NHC ADVISORIES FOR LATEST WATCH/WARNING INFORMATION AND TRACK/INTENSITY GUIDANCE ON TS ANA. ..EDWARDS/GLEASON.. 05/09/2015

sections.title: SRN PLNS TO ARKLATEX TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: ANOTHER COMPLEX CONVECTIVE SCENARIO IS EXPECTED TO UNFOLD OVER THE SRN PLNS...WITH SEVERAL AREAS OF ENHANCED CONCERN. FIRST...HEATING ALONG DIFFUSE W-E OUTFLOW BOUNDARY OVER N CNTRL/NE TX EWD INTO THE ARKLATEX MAY BE THE FOCUS FOR SCTD SUPERCELLS/SUPERCELL CLUSTERS LATER TODAY INTO TNGT AS SFC HEATING DESTABILIZES AMPLY SHEARED REGION. FARTHER S AND W...OTHER STORMS MAY INITIATE WITH DIURNAL HEATING ALONG TRAILING DRY LINE/LEE TROUGH SEGMENTS OVER THE TX HILL COUNTRY. AND...ONE OR TWO SUPERCELLS MAY ARISE SE OF EXISTING STORMS NOW NEAR CDS. THIS ACTIVITY WILL ALSO HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO SPAWN A COUPLE TORNADOES...IN ADDITION TO VERY LARGE HAIL AND /MAINLY NARROW/ CORRIDORS OF DMGG WIND. LATE TNGT AND EARLY SUN...A SEPARATE AREA OF SVR STORMS /MAINLY WITH LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DMGG WIND/ MAY ARISE ALONG TRAILING SW PART OF LEE TROUGH/PACIFIC FRONT AS THE BOUNDARIES BECOME QSTNRY OVER SW TX/THE TX BIG BEND.

sections.title: PRIMARY CHANGES TO THE DAY-1 CONVECTIVE OUTLOOK
sections.text: /1/ PORTIONS OF NORTH CENTRAL TEXAS INCLUDING THE DFW METROPLEX HAVE BEEN UPGRADED TO MODERATE RISK FOR AN INCREASED RISK OF TORNADOES...SOME POSSIBLY STRONG...FOR THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING. THE SPECIAL 19Z SOUNDING FROM FORT WORTH SAMPLES AROUND 8 C/KM LAPSE RATES IN THE H7-H5 LAYER SURMOUNTING LOWER 70S DEWPOINTS SUPPORTING STRONG INSTABILITY. CONVECTION IS ALREADY DEVELOPING AT THE ERN EDGE OF THE STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATE PLUME NOSING INTO SRN PARTS OF THE LOW ROLLING PLAINS...WITH DEEPENING CONVECTIVE TOWERS ALREADY NOTED IN THIS REGIME PER VIS IMAGERY AND RADAR TRENDS. THIS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO FURTHER INTENSIFY WITH SUPERCELLS EXPECTED TO SPREAD EWD ACROSS THE MODERATE RISK AREA INTO THE EVENING. THE AREAS AT GREATEST RISK FOR TORNADOES...LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE ACROSS NORTH TEXAS...SOUTHERN OKLAHOMA INTO SOUTHWEST ARKANSAS THIS EVENING WITH ANOTHER AREA OF SEVERE STORMS LOCATED IN WESTERN KANSAS.

sections.title: WEST AND SOUTHWEST TX
sections.text: A RETREATING DRYLINE IS CURRENTLY MOVING NWWD ACROSS THE PECOS VALLEY FROM ERN PARTS OF BREWSTER COUNTY NEWD TO WEST OF SAN ANGELO. SHORT-TERM MODEL FORECASTS MERGE A PACIFIC FRONT WITH THE RETREATING DRYLINE AND DEVELOP THUNDERSTORMS ALONG THE BOUNDARIES...MOVING THIS ACTIVITY EWD ACROSS WCNTRL TX DURING THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD. MODERATE INSTABILITY AND STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR COMBINED WITH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR HAIL WITH THE STRONGER CORES...SEE MCD 577.

sections.title: SRN PLAINS
sections.text: THE LATEST WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS SOUTHWEST FLOW IN PLACE ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS. A WELL-DEFINED DRYLINE IS LOCATED ACROSS WCNTRL TX WITH MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY PRESENT TO THE EAST OF THE DRYLINE ACROSS NCNTRL AND NE TX. SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING ALONG THE INSTABILITY AXIS FROM NORTHEAST OF WICHITA FALLS SWD TO NEAR STEPHENVILLE TX. THE FORTH WORTH 00Z SOUNDING SHOWS MLCAPE JUST ABOVE 2500 J/KG WITH NEARLY 50 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR AND MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES APPROACHING 8.0 C/KM. THIS SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL THROUGH MID EVENING. HAILSTONES OF GREATER THAN 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE DOMINANT SUPERCELLS. IN ADDITION...A LOW-LEVEL JET IS FORECAST TO STRENGTHEN ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS EARLY THIS EVENING CREATING A SHEAR ENVIRONMENT FAVORABLE FOR TORNADOES WITH THE MORE DOMINANT SUPERCELLS. FURTHER TO THE EAST...SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING ALONG A SHARP GRADIENT OF INSTABILITY FROM THE RED RIVER VALLEY EXTENDING EWD INTO THE ARKLATEX. DUE TO STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR AND ADEQUATE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR...THESE STORMS WILL ALSO ROTATE AND BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND POSS

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: THE LATEST WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW OVER SERN CO WITH A DRY-SLOT LOCATED FROM SE NM NEWD INTO THE TX PANHANDLE. THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING AHEAD OF THE DRYSLOT ACROSS WRN KS IN THE EXIT REGION OF A 60 TO 75 KT MID-LEVEL JET. THE DODGE CITY 00Z SOUNDING SHOWS SBCAPE NEAR 1000 J/KG WITH 70 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR WITH 700 TO 500 MB LAPSE RATES NEAR 8.0 C/KM. THIS SHOULD SUPPORT SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL WHERE STORMS CAN ORGANIZE SUFFICIENTLY. IN ADDITION...LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL STRENGTHEN AS A LOW-LEVEL JET DEVELOPS ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS THIS EVENING. THIS SHOULD MAKE CONDITIONS FAVORABLE FOR A FEW TORNADOES WITH THE MORE ROBUST ROTATING STORMS.

sections.title: ERN SC/ERN NC
sections.text: TROPICAL STORM ANA IS FORECAST BY THE NATIONAL HURRICANE CENTER TO MOVE ONSHORE NEAR MYRTLE BEACH TONIGHT. AS CONVECTION WRAPS AROUND THE NORTH SIDE OF THE CENTER OF ANNA...A FEW ROTATING STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE FROM FAR ERN SC ALONG THE ERN NC COAST. STRONG LOW-LEVEL WINDS EVIDENT ON THE MOREHEAD CITY 00Z SOUNDING COULD BE ENOUGH FOR A MARGINAL WIND DAMAGE THREAT WITH LOW-TOPPED STORMS THAT MOVE ONSHORE DURING THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD. ..BROYLES.. 05/10/2015

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE BY AFTERNOON WITH AN INCREASING RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL AND POTENTIALLY SOME TORNADO RISK FROM PARTS OF NORTH TX/SOUTHEAST OK TOWARD WESTERN AR/NORTHWEST LA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTIPLE STORM CLUSTERS PERSIST EAST-NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL TX/SOUTH-CENTRAL OK AT MID-MORNING...WITH THE STRONGEST CLUSTER ONGOING JUST NORTH-NORTHWEST OF THE DFW METROPLEX. RELATIVELY THICK CLOUD COVER STILL PERSISTS TO THE EAST...BUT SOME CLOUD BREAKS AND A VERY MOIST AIR MASS...PARTICULARLY NEAR/SOUTH OF A WEST-EAST ARCING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS NORTHEAST TX...SHOULD ALLOW FOR ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT/INTENSIFICATION AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER HEATS. WHILE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR APPEARS TO WEAKEN WITH EASTWARD EXTENT...MOIST EASTERLY LOWER-LEVEL INFLOW WILL SUPPORT RELATIVELY ORGANIZED STORM MODES POTENTIALLY INCLUDING BOWING CLUSTERS WITH SOME EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL REMAINS POSSIBLE PRIMARY ACROSS SOUTHWEST OK/ADJACENT WESTERN NORTH TX IN ADDITION TO PORTIONS OF WEST-CENTRAL/SOUTH-CENTRAL KS. THUNDERSTORM WATCH 148 CONTINUES UNTIL 19Z. PORTIONS OF THE WATCH MAY WARRANT REPLACEMENT AND/OR A NEW WATCH DOWNSTREAM BY EARLY AFTERNOON...ESPECIALLY ACROSS SOUTHERN OK/FAR NORTH TX.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONGER CONVECTION CONTINUES TO PROPAGATE ALONG/JUST BEHIND ARCING OUTFLOW FROM SOUTHWEST/SOUTH-CENTRAL KS SOUTH-SOUTHWESTWARD INTO SOUTHWEST OK AND IMMEDIATELY ADJACENT NORTH TX. AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION NEAR/EAST OF THE MAJORITY OF THIS LINEAR CONVECTION HAS BEEN HINDERED BY EARLIER OUTFLOW NEAR/JUST SOUTH OF THE RED RIVER AND LINGERING CLOUD COVER. HOWEVER...STEADY LOW-LEVEL MOISTENING/MODEST HEATING CONTINUES TO OCCUR WITH LIMITED CLOUD BREAKS NOTED ACROSS OK. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS/SOME HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE PRIMARILY ACROSS SOUTHWEST OK/ADJACENT TX AS WELL AS WEST-CENTRAL/SOUTH-CENTRAL KS THROUGH EARLY AFTERNOON. ..GUYER.. 05/09/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS EASTERN CO AND WESTERN KS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. LARGE HAIL...TORNADOES...AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE LIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EXIT REGION OF STRONG MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX HAS ROTATED INTO SERN CO AND ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS FEATURE IS EXPECTED TO SPREAD NEWD INTO NWRN KS BY LATE AFTERNOON. STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING ACROSS THE SRN HIGH PLAINS HAS CONTRIBUTED TO STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND LATEST DIAGNOSTIC DATA SUGGESTS SFC-3KM VALUES ARE APPROACHING 9 C/KM ALONG THE FRONT RANGE OF SERN CO/NERN NM. VIS IMAGERY SUPPORTS THIS WITH AN EXPANDING/DEEPENING CU FIELD ALONG THE SERN CO/NERN NM BORDER RIDGE...NWD ALONG THE SANGRE DE CRISTO RANGE WEST OF PUB. OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...SUPERCELLS SHOULD EVOLVE WITHIN FAVORABLY MOIST UPSLOPE REGIME AND TRACK NNEWD AHEAD OF DEVELOPING/SURGING SFC LOW. LARGE HAIL WILL BE COMMON WITH THIS ACTIVITY AND TORNADOES ARE ALSO EXPECTED WITH THE MOST ORGANIZED SUPERCELLS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME TORNADO/HAIL RISK...A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED THIS AFTERNOON FOR ADDITIONAL PARTS OF NORTHEAST TX/FAR EASTERN OK INTO PORTIONS OF AR/FAR NORTHERN LA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS MERGERS HAVE LEAD TO AN INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED UPSCALE-GROWING QUASI-LINEAR COMPLEX ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST OK SOUTHWESTWARD INTO FAR NORTHEAST TX GENERALLY NEAR/WEST OF THE PARIS TX AREA AS OF 19Z. MUCH OF THIS ACTIVITY IS FOCUSED ALONG/NORTH OF PRIOR OUTFLOW ACROSS FAR NORTHEAST TX AND NEAR AR/LA BORDER VICINITY...WITH GRADUAL WARMING/DESTABILIZATION OCCURRING TO THE NORTH INTO AR AMID MODEST CLOUD BREAK. AS STORMS CONTINUE TO INTENSIFY...INCREASINGLY STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR...ACCENTUATED BY STRONG TURNING IN THE LOW-LEVELS...WILL SUPPORT A MIXED CONVECTIVE MODE WITH A FEW EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS ASIDE FROM MORE PREVALENT QUASI-LINEAR/SMALL BOWING STRUCTURES. DAMAGING WINDS WILL LIKELY BE THE PRIMARY RISK...BUT A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE...AND SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE MAINLY ON THE SOUTH-SOUTHWEST FLANK OF THE EVOLVING COMPLEX OF STORMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LARGE HAIL AND TORNADO POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO STEADILY INCREASE ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL TX THROUGH EARLY EVENING...INITIALLY IN AREAS JUST TO THE WEST OF THE DFW METROPLEX VICINITY. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS/MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND POSSIBLY SOME TORNADO RISK WILL OTHERWISE CONTINUE ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL OK/FAR NORTHEAST TX. TORNADO WATCH 150 CONTINUES UNTIL 02Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY-RELATED EFFECTIVE WARM FRONT EXTENDS ROUGHLY WEST-EAST ACROSS FAR NORTH TX ROUGHLY ALONG THE NORTHERN EDGE OF THE METROPLEX AND THE ADJACENT NORTHERN TWO-TIERS OF COUNTIES OF NORTH TX. STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ALONG THE I-20 CORRIDOR IN VICINITY OF BRECKENRIDGE/BROWNWOOD/STEPHENVILLE VICINITIES NEAR A SURFACE LOW/DRYLINE THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON. AS AT LEAST ISOLATED STORMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP/MATURE AND SPREAD NORTHEASTWARD...LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE...AND TORNADOES /INCLUDING A STRONG TORNADO RISK/ WOULD ESPECIALLY BE A CONCERN AS STORMS ENCOUNTER A STRONGER CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL SOUTHERLY WINDS TO THE EAST AND/OR INTERACT WITH THE AFOREMENTIONED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. A SPECIAL 19Z OBSERVED SOUNDING FROM DALLAS-FORT WORTH SAMPLED A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER /LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS/ WITH 300+ M2/S2 EFFECTIVE SRH. FARTHER NORTH...THE PRIMARY SCENARIO WILL BE FOR CONTINUED STORM MERGERS AHEAD OF SOUTHEASTWARD-PROPAGATING OUTFLOW CURRENTLY ACROSS PORTIONS OF SOUTHWEST/SOUTH-CENTRAL OK. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS/SOME HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARDS ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL OK. ..GUYER.. 05/09/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS EASTERN COLORADO AND WESTERN KS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY ACROSS TORNADO WATCH OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. LATEST VIS IMAGERY CONTINUES TO SUGGEST CONVECTION OVER SERN CO IS EXPANDING/DEEPENING WITH SUBSTANTIAL VENTING APPARENT IN ANVIL SPREADING. EXIT REGION OF UPPER JET SHOULD ENCOURAGE FURTHER SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT WITHIN FAVORABLE SELY LOW-LEVEL FLOW. DOWNSTREAM AIR MASS IS GRADUALLY DESTABILIZING PER NWD-DEVELOPING CU FIELD. WHILE WARM FRONT HAS BEEN STUBBORN TO ADVANCE NORTH OF I-70...SUFFICIENTLY BUOYANT AIR MASS SHOULD SPREAD INTO NERN CO TO SUPPORT SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT LATER THIS AFTERNOON. ..DARROW.. 05/09/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DISCRETE TSTMS APPEAR TO BE INITIATING ALONG THE MERGED DRYLINE/CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW. ALTHOUGH UNCERTAINTY EXISTS IN THE DEGREE OF BUOYANCY IN THE WAKE OF THE DOWNSTREAM OUTFLOW-MODIFIED AIR MASS...AN ISOLATED RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADIC SUPERCELL MAY DEVELOP.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 21Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A DRYLINE FROM HANSFORD TO COTTLE COUNTY TX. TSTM INITIATION HAS OCCURRED OVER DONLEY COUNTY WITH ANOTHER SHOWER EVIDENT IN GRAY COUNTY. HOW UNSTABLE THE AIR MASS E OF THE DRYLINE IS QUESTIONABLE GIVEN THE EXTENSIVE OVERTURNING EARLIER TODAY. IT DOES APPEAR THAT THE NWRN EXTENT OF MIDDLE 60S SURFACE DEW POINTS REMAINS FROM THE SERN TX PANHANDLE INTO SWRN OK. WITH CONTINUED ROBUST INSOLATION...IT APPEARS PLAUSIBLE THAT SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY WOULD EXIST FOR SUSTAINING DEEP CONVECTION ALONG THE DRYLINE. DEEP-LAYER WIND PROFILES WOULD FAVOR SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH LARGE HAIL AS THE MAIN RISK...ALTHOUGH A TORNADO OR TWO IS POSSIBLE AS WELL GIVEN SOME ENLARGEMENT TO LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS DUE TO PERSISTENT E/SELY NEAR-SURFACE WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED RISK FOR PREDOMINATELY DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO MAY DEVELOP E/N FROM SWRN AR. AN AREAL EXTENSION OF WW 151 HAS BEEN COORDINATED WITH WFO LZK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LEADING EDGE OF CONVECTIVE CLUSTER OVER SWRN AR WILL EVOLVE EWD WITHIN A RATHER MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS PRESENT OVER THE SRN HALF OF AR WITH NEAR 80/70 DEG F SURFACE T/TD. DEEP SHEAR DOES WEAKEN WITH ERN EXTENT WITH MAINLY UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES. BUT LZK VWP DATA SAMPLED 0-6 KM VALUES AROUND 35 KT...SUFFICIENT FOR UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION AND THE PREDOMINANT RISK OF LOCALIZED DAMAGING WINDS. ..GRAMS.. 05/09/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ALL SEVERE HAZARDS REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS AMIDST CLUSTERS EVOLVING E/NE ALONG LARGE-SCALE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 22Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A LARGE-SCALE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM THE ARKLATEX BORDER AREA WWD ALONG THE RED RIVER. THE MORE WELL-DEFINED PORTION OF THE BOUNDARY IS OVER THE ARKLATEX WHERE A SUPERCELL IS PRESENT IN BOWIE COUNTY TX. WITH THE WARMEST OF WARM SECTOR AIR CHARACTERIZED BY NEAR UPPER 80S SURFACE TEMPERATURES OVER THE SABINE VALLEY...THIS STORM COULD POTENTIALLY HAVE A MORE PERSISTENT TORNADO RISK AS IT APPROACHES THE TEXARKANA AREA. FARTHER W...FWS VWP DATA CONTINUES TO DEPICT THE STRONGEST OF LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR WITH 0-1 KM VALUES AROUND 25 KT. ALTHOUGH RELATIVELY MESSY MODE MAY TEMPER THE LONGEVITY OF ANY INDIVIDUAL SUPERCELL...ENVIRONMENT WILL REMAIN SUPPORTIVE FOR ROTATING UPDRAFTS AND ALL SEVERE HAZARDS. ..GRAMS.. 05/09/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A TORNADO THREAT WILL CONTINUE THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS PARTS OF EASTERN CO AND WESTERN KS. LARGE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS ALSO WILL BE POSSIBLE. THE GREATEST THREAT WILL BE OVER EAST-CENTRAL CO INTO WESTERN KS AS ISOLATED STORMS TRACK GENERALLY NORTH/NORTHEAST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE SURFACE WARM FRONT HAS BEEN SLOWLY LIFTING NORTHWARD THIS AFTERNOON. THE BEST TORNADO ENVIRONMENT WILL EXIST FROM E-CENTRAL CO INTO WRN KS IN A NARROW WEDGE OF WARM SECTOR AIR EAST OF THE DRYLINE AND SOUTH OF THE WARM FRONT. MODEST SURFACE BASED CAPE AND 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 50 KT WILL BE ADEQUATE FOR SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. THE 23Z GLD VWP INDICATED A SMALL BUT FAVORABLE LOW LEVEL HODOGRAPH WITH AROUND 150 M2/S2 0-3KM SRH. GIVEN THE VICINITY TO THE SURFACE LOW AND THE FAVORABLE SHEAR/THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT WITH PLENTY OF SFC BOUNDARIES IN THE REGION...THE TORNADO THREAT LIKELY WILL CONTINUE FOR AT LEAST A COUPLE MORE HOURS. IN ADDITION TO TORNADO...HAIL AND GUSTY WIND ALSO WILL BE POSSIBLE. ..LEITMAN.. 05/09/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ALL SEVERE HAZARDS REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH DISCRETE SUPERCELLS THAT APPEAR TO BE EVOLVING INTO SMALL CLUSTERS. VERY LARGE HAIL SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD ALONG WITH AN OCCASIONAL TORNADO OR TWO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN INITIALLY INTENSE DRYLINE SUPERCELL OVER EASTLAND COUNTY WEAKENED AS IT PROGRESSED E OF THE DRYLINE. BEST LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND OVERLAP OF THERMAL/MOIST AXES REMAIN IN THIS CORRIDOR OF THE DRYLINE PER 23Z SURFACE ANALYSIS. WITH VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATING AGITATED CU TO THE CONCHO VALLEY...CONTINUED UPSHEAR DEVELOPMENT APPEARS PROBABLE WITH PRECIP SEEDING LIMITING THE INTENSITY OF DOWNSHEAR STORMS. ALTHOUGH ALL SEVERE HAZARDS ARE CERTAINLY POSSIBLE...THE RISK FOR A LONG-LIVED/STRONG TORNADO MAY HAVE PEAKED. ..GRAMS.. 05/09/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WITH WW 150 SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE AT 02Z...PORTIONS OF THE WW WILL NEED TO BE EITHER LOCALLY EXTENDED OR REPLACED WITH A NEW TORNADO WATCH. SPC IS COORDINATING WITH AFFECTED WFOS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERE RISK SHOULD PERSIST INTO LATE EVENING ALONG THE LARGE-SCALE OUTFLOW NEAR THE RED RIVER AND WITH A SUPERCELL/STORM-SCALE BOW THAT HAS ACCELERATED E SW OF THE METROPLEX. 00Z FWD RAOB SAMPLED MINIMAL INHIBITION SUGGESTING A TORNADO THREAT WILL CONTINUE THROUGH ABOUT 04Z AS SURFACE-BASED INFLOW PARCELS ARE MAINTAINED AMIDST 0-1 KM SHEAR AROUND 30 KT. ADDITIONAL STORMS SHOULD FORM FARTHER SW LATER TONIGHT AS THE PACIFIC FRONT IMPINGES ON THE RETREATING DRYLINE OVER THE EDWARDS PLATEAU/CONCHO VALLEY. BUT THIS ACTIVITY WOULD BE MORE OF A LARGE HAIL THREAT. ..GRAMS.. 05/10/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE RISK WITH LARGE HAIL AS THE PRIMARY HAZARD SHOULD EXIST FOR 2-3 HOURS THIS EVENING. SPATIOTEMPORAL EXTENT OF THE RISK APPEARS MARGINAL TO WARRANT A SEVERE TSTM WATCH ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION THAT INITIATED OVER NE MEXICO RAPIDLY INTENSIFIED ALONG AND E OF THE RIO GRANDE IN MAVERICK COUNTY WITH BOTH LEFT/RIGHT-SPLITTING CELLS. ALONG THE EDGE OF THE THERMAL AXIS CHARACTERIZED BY MIDDLE TO UPPER 90S SURFACE TEMPERATURES...MODIFIED 00Z DRT RAOB SUGGESTS VERY LARGE BUOYANCY EXISTS AMIDST AN ELONGATED HODOGRAPH WITH 50-KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR. THIS SHOULD FAVOR A COUPLE HOURS OF SPLITTING SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND LOCALIZED SEVERE WINDS. BUT WITH THE ONSET OF NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY-LAYER COOLING...MLCIN SHOULD INCREASE RAPIDLY AND ACTIVITY SHOULD STRUGGLE TO MAINTAIN SURFACE-BASED INFLOW WITH ERN EXTENT GIVEN PROGRESSIVELY COOLER TEMPERATURES OVER THE BRUSH COUNTRY. OVERALL RISK SHOULD BE WANING AFTER 03Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO WATCH 149 HAS BEEN EXTENDED EASTWARD TO ACCOUNT FOR INCREASED SEVERE THREAT INTO PARTS OF CENTRAL KS. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED AND A NEW WATCH MAY BE NEEDED IF THE THREAT APPEARS IT WILL EXTEND MUCH PAST THE 03Z EXPIRATION TIME. HAIL AND A TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH STORMS TRACKING INTO CENTRAL KS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE SEVERE THREAT MAY SPREAD EAST OF TORNADO WATCH 149 OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. FOR NOW...AN AERIAL EXTENSION BY WFO DDC AND GLD SHOULD CONTAIN THE THREAT. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED AND A NEW WATCH MAY BE NEEDED IF THE THREAT BECOMES MORE WIDESPREAD OR APPEARS THAT IT WILL LAST MUCH BEYOND THE 03Z EXPIRATION TIME. THE AIRMASS OVER CENTRAL KS IS MODESTLY UNSTABLE...BUT WITH LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING...ANY SURFACE BASED CONVECTION MAY STRUGGLE TO REMAIN SO AS SBCIN INCREASES. THE EXCEPTION MAY BE WITH ANY STORM THAT INTERACTS WITH THE WARM FRONT OR ANY OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. BASED ON LATEST ICT AND DDC VWP AND THE DDC 00Z RAOB...ANY SURFACE BASED CONVECTION WILL POSE A RISK FOR TORNADOES GIVEN FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR PROFILES. MODEST MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND 500 MB TEMPS NEAR -15C WILL ALSO FAVOR SEVERE HAIL WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS. WHILE STORM EVOLUTION IS UNCLEAR...SOME MODELS SUGGEST A BROKEN LINE OF STORMS MAY DEVELOP AND TRACK E/NE ACROSS CENTRAL KS. IF ANY COLD POOL IS ABLE TO BE ESTABLISHED...STRONG WINDS ALSO WILL BE POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTER OF STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS SHOULD GRADUALLY WANE OVER SRN AR. ALTHOUGH AN ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND/BRIEF TORNADO RISK MAY PERSIST BEYOND 03Z WW EXPIRATION...A REPLACEMENT WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONGEST STORMS WITHIN WW 151 HAVE PERSISTED OVER SWRN AR N OF THE LARGE-SCALE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT EXTENDS FROM SERN AR TO NEAR THE ARKLATEX BORDER REGION. LOW-LEVEL WINDS HAVE NOCTURNALLY INCREASED PER SHV/LZK VWP DATA AND WAA ATOP THE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW SHOULD MAINTAIN TSTMS THROUGH AT LEAST MIDNIGHT. HOWEVER...00Z SHV RAOB WAS NOT PARTICULARLY UNSTABLE WITH MEAN MIXING RATIOS ONLY AROUND 12-13 G/KG. AS SUCH...OVERALL CONVECTIVE INTENSITY WILL PROBABLY WANE SUGGESTING THE RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND A BRIEF TORNADO WILL SUBSIDE THROUGH LATE EVENING. ..GRAMS.. 05/10/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS TSTMS ARE LIKELY TO DEVELOP THROUGH MIDNIGHT AS THE PACIFIC COLD FRONT IMPINGES ON THE RETREATING DRYLINE OVER THE ERN PERMIAN BASIN AND CONCHO VALLEY. LARGE HAIL SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD. POTENTIAL WW ISSUANCE MAY ALSO INCLUDE REPLACING PORTIONS OF EXTENDED WW 149 THAT EXPIRES AT 04Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 02Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED THE RETREATING DRYLINE FROM BREWSTER COUNTY TO NEAR SJT AND ABI. A SURGE OF NWLY SURFACE WINDS HAS REACHED HOWARD TO PECOS COUNTY BEHIND A WEAK PACIFIC COLD FRONT. IR SATELLITE IMAGERY CONFIRM INITIAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT OVER PECOS COUNTY. WITH 40-KT LOW-LEVEL SELYS SAMPLED IN KDFX VWP DATA...CONTINUED MOIST ADVECTION FROM THE EDWARDS PLATEAU/BIG COUNTRY/LOWER RIO GRANDE VALLEY IN CONJUNCTION WITH CONVERGENCE ALONG THE FRONT SHOULD RESULT IN DEEP CONVECTION BLOSSOMING THROUGH MIDNIGHT. STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND STRONG EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL FAVOR LARGE HAIL PRODUCTION...SOME OF WHICH MAY BE SIGNIFICANT ESPECIALLY IN THE FIRST HOUR OR TWO AFTER INITIATION. CONVECTION-ALLOWING GUIDANCE REMAINS QUITE CONSISTENT IN DEPICTING RAPID CLUSTERING MODE WITH UPDRAFTS LIKELY GETTING UNDERCUT BY COMPOSITE FRONT/OUTFLOW. THIS SHOULD TEND TO TEMPER THE OVERALL SEVERE RISK OVERNIGHT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF ISOLD LARGE HAIL AND SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE UP TO AND PROBABLY BEYOND THE 08Z EXPIRATION TIME OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 152. A LOCAL EXTENSION-IN-TIME OR A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL PROBABLY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED TO ADDRESS THIS SITUATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC AT 07Z SHOWS A LINE OF CELLS EXTENDING FROM PECOS COUNTY NEWD ACROSS THE CONCHO RIVER VALLEY AND INTO NOLAN COUNTY. SEVERAL MORE INTENSE CELLULAR CORES ARE EVIDENT WITHIN THE CONVECTIVE LINE AND WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO POSE AT LEAST A LARGE-HAIL THREAT GIVEN STRONG SHEAR PROFILES AND MODERATE BUOYANCY. THE 40+ KT SLY LLJ OVER THE EDWARDS PLATEAU AND AN ORGANIZED COLD POOL WILL PROBABLY ACT TO SUSTAIN THE STORM ACTIVITY FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. AS A RESULT...AN ISOLD LARGE-HAIL THREAT WILL PROBABLY CONTINUE AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE INVOF THE STRONGER CORES. ..SMITH.. 05/10/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLD STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH APPEARS UNNECESSARY AT THIS TIME BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A WEST-EAST ORIENTED CLUSTER OF STORMS MOVING EWD ACROSS THE GREATER FSM AREA EWD INTO N-CNTRL AR. THE KFSM ASOS RECORDED A 47 KT WIND GUST WITH PASSAGE OF A BOWING SEGMENT AROUND 07Z. ALTHOUGH SOME NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY LAYER DECOUPLING HAS LIKELY OCCURRED...MOIST LOW LEVELS CHARACTERIZED BY MID 60S DEWPOINTS ARE CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE BUOYANCY ACCORDING TO OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS /1000-1500 J PER KG MUCAPE/. THE KLZK VAD SHOWS A STRONG AND VEERING LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPH WHICH SHOULD SUPPORT STORM ORGANIZATION. AS A RESULT...A FEW STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS MAY ACCOMPANY SEVERAL OF THE STRONGER STORMS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS THIS ACTIVITY MOVES GENERALLY EWD ACROSS N-CNTRL AR. GIVEN THE ANTICIPATED COVERAGE AND MARGINAL THREAT FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS...A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL PROBABLY NOT BE NEEDED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT AND INTENSIFICATION IS PROBABLE AS STORMS MOVE DOWNSTREAM INTO A MOIST/UNSTABLE AXIS LOCATED ACROSS N-CNTRL TX INTO S-CNTRL AND SWRN OK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC AND 09Z SUBJECTIVE SURFACE MESOANALYSIS SHOWS A BOWING SEGMENT MOVING ENEWD ACROSS THE TX BIG COUNTRY AROUND 45 KT AND INTO A MOIST/UNSTABLE AXIS. AN EARLIER OUTFLOW BOUNDARY LOCATED ACROSS N-CNTRL TX APPEARS MORE DIFFUSE WITH TIME AND AN INFLUX OF MORE MOIST AIR CHARACTERIZED BY AN AXIS OF UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS EXTENDS FROM E-CNTRL TX NWWD THROUGH THE METROPLEX AND INTO SWRN AND INTO S-CNTRL OK. RECENT ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED ACROSS WRN N-CNTRL TX AND BOTH STORM CLUSTERS WILL MOVE DOWNSTREAM. THE SCTD DEVELOPMENT SW OF SPS IS CAPABLE OF AN ISOLD LARGE-HAIL THREAT IN ADDITION TO A STRONG WIND GUST. THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH THE BOW WILL BE POCKETS OF SEVERE WIND GUSTS 60-70 MPH BUT SMALL HAIL COULD ACCOMPANY THE MORE INTENSE UPDRAFTS...ESPECIALLY ON THE SRN FLANK OF THE BOW. ..SMITH.. 05/10/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE NEED FOR AN ADDITIONAL WATCH REMAINS LOW AT THIS TIME. A STRONG WIND GUST RISK MAY DEVELOP WITH THE QLCS AS IT MOVES INTO NERN TX AND ADJACENT PARTS OF OK/AR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC AT 1140Z SHOWS A QLCS FROM NEAR THE RED RIVER ALONG THE I-35 CORRIDOR TRAILING SWD TO 30 MI WNW ACT. RECENT SURFACE OBSERVATIONS HAVE SAMPLED GUSTS IN THE 30-50 MPH RANGE /SUB-SEVERE/ ALTHOUGH LOCALIZED HIGHER GUSTS MAY STILL BE ACCOMPANYING THE MORE PRECIP-LADEN CORES OR MESOVORTICES. SURFACE CONDITIONS AHEAD OF THE QLCS ARE LOWER 70S TEMPS WITH NEAR 70 DEG F DEWPOINTS. WIDESPREAD CLOUD COVER OVER THE DISCUSSION AREA WILL TEND TO SLOW DIABATIC HEATING/DESTABILIZATION THIS MORNING AND THE PERCEIVED NEED FOR AN ADDITIONAL DOWNSTREAM WATCH IS LOW AT THIS TIME. NONETHELESS...ADEQUATE SHEAR/BUOYANCY FOR STORM ORGANIZATION WILL LEND SOME TEMPERED POSSIBILITY FOR AN UPTICK IN A WIND GUST THREAT. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED OVER THE MORNING HOURS.
